title: Completion from a fixed sign assignment
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $J$ be a set of coordinates among the $n$ coordinates, let $z$ assign a sign to every coordinate outside $J$, and let $x$ be a sign vector of length $n$. The sign vector obtained by completing the restriction that leaves $J$ free and fixes every coordinate outside $J$ according to $z$, using $x$ on the free coordinates, is the vector formed from the restriction of $x$ to $J$ and the assignment $z$ outside $J$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a set of coordinates among the $n$ coordinates
$x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
